adjudication.purpose: Rank 43 newly discovered material funding-schedule source change; source and retained counterpart gate only.
adjudication.novelty: Exact article code absent from retained non-raw source contracts, results and journals before this freeze. Search discovery values are not economic evidence.
adjudication.source_representation: UTF-8 Binance CMS JSON with exact successful article identity. Decode body JSON node/child/text recursively; normalize HTML entities and nonbreaking spaces only. Retain bytes before decoding. Required phrases are source-observed exact symbols/date, not guessed formatting of rate clauses.
adjudication.counterpart_gate: Use all returned inventory rows, require unique integer IDs and symbols plus nonempty base/quote identity. Compare each announced contract label without its exact USDT suffix to exact base_asset only. No aliases, share-class mapping, currency parity or name-only hedge assumptions. Exact label is necessary here, not sufficient proof of matching units or settlement. Retain every sibling decision and inventory identity projection.
adjudication.consequences: If a sibling has no exact counterpart in the retained snapshot, stop it before funding, price, fee, book or account requests. A matching label merely routes separate unit/share-class/settlement qualification after the source passes; this contract authorizes no downstream requests. Changes are not effective until the exact source time; never infer more expected income from shorter intervals or doubled settlement count.
adjudication.failure: Retain failed source and journal. No refetch, alias, new inventory request, economic request, or relaxation after access. Any zero-network adjudication remains explicitly source-only.
adjudication.retry: Independently observed exact counterpart listing or source-proved conversion architecture, or later material exact funding/fee/settlement change. Passage of September 10 alone cannot reopen a missing-counterpart population.
